extracted.name: Once upon a thyme in Mexico
extracted.description: Fresh raspberries and aromatic thyme enhance the vibrant, fruity flavours of the mezcal in this summery cocktail
instruction_lines: Put all the ingredients in a cocktail shaker and fill with ice. Shake hard to combine and ensure the raspberries break up. Fine strain into a martini glass or coupette, and garnish with a sprig of thyme, attaching with a mini peg if you have one.
